## Critique
- claim-1: Supported by [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 207-218; 263-269]. The Schur basis is integral, and truncation to \(q^r\) introduces no rationalization.
- claim-2: Supported by [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 219-235]. Admissibility also gives \(1\le i\le q\) and \(1\le j\le r\).
- claim-3: The proof is complete. The source-backed ring involution \(\omega(s_\lambda)=s_{\lambda'}\) and
  \[
  \lambda\nsubseteq q^r\iff\lambda'\nsubseteq r^q
  \]
  imply \(\omega(I_{r,q})=I_{q,r}\). Hence the map descends over \(\mathbb Z\), preserves partition weight, and has inverse \(\omega_{q,r}\).
- claim-4: Under the accepted interval presentation, conjugation sends the basis interval exactly to
  \[
  \bigoplus_{j^i\subseteq\mu\subseteq r^q}\mathbb Z\bar s_\mu.
  \]
  The parameter calculation is correct:
  \[
  t^\vee=q-i+1,\qquad s^\vee=q+j-i,
  \]
  and
  \[
  (i^\vee,j^\vee,a^\vee,b^\vee)=(j,i,a,b).
  \]
  The inequalities
  \[
  1\le t^\vee\le q,\quad t^\vee\le s^\vee\le n,\quad
  t^\vee-(q+s^\vee-n)=r-j+1>0
  \]
  establish transformed admissibility.
- claim-5: The descent is valid because the graded algebra isomorphism maps \(A_{r,q,+}\) onto \(A_{q,r,+}\), so
  \[
  \omega(A_{r,q,+}J_v)=A_{q,r,+}J_{v^\vee}.
  \]
  The induced inverse is obtained from \(\omega_{q,r}\). Its degreewise matrices are integral permutation matrices; therefore torsion subgroups, element orders, and degreewise free ranks are preserved. Partition weight and ordinary cohomological degree \(2|\lambda|\) are both preserved.
- Boundary audit: nonidentity bigrassmannian admissibility forces \(r,q\ge1\); \(i,j\ge1\), \(a\ge0\), and \(b\ge1\). Cases \(r=1\), \(q=1\), \(i=q\), \(j=r\), \(a=0\), \(j-b=0\), and \(i-b=0\) introduce no exception. If \(i=q\) or \(j=r\), the auxiliary lower/right generator-index intervals collapse when \(a=0\), but the additive ideal interval \(i^j\subseteq\lambda\subseteq q^r\) need not be a singleton. If \(i=q\) and \(j=r\), it is the singleton top class and \(A_+J_v=0\).
- No finite \(G_L\)-to-\(G_R\) transition computation was used.

## Required revisions
- Clarify that the “single core shape” assertion for \(a=0\) concerns the auxiliary generator families, not the additive Schur-basis interval for \(J_v\).
- The requested quotient-conjugation target was established; no repair certificate is required.
